limitations: Diagnostic RTX 5000 measurements; not idle-historical_cpu_worker performance acceptance.
CPU parity reference solve was single-shot; these results do not certify repeated end-to-end CPU versus GPU speedup.
First case total includes cold native setup in its first direct sample; do not use its total speedup as acceptance.
Graph capture and instantiation costs are included in each solve. Graph remains opt-in.
GPU memory is live allocation delta, not measured peak.
Build receipts retain pre-commit dirty source provenance; source hashes identify tested development artifacts. No release deployment.
